"""Camera-derived joint-space controller for the VLABench heat_food episode.

The program logs each commanded move and keeps snapshots under /app/output.
It uses a geometric Panda model calibrated to the robot's reported TCP pose;
object waypoints come only from RGB/depth observations.
"""
import json, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT=Path('/app/output'); OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
LIM=np.array([[-2.8973,2.8973],[-1.7628,1.7628],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-3.0718,-.0698],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-.0175,3.7525],[-2.8973,2.8973]])
RBASE=Rot.from_euler('z',90,degrees=True).as_matrix()

def ht(t=(0,0,0),rx=0,rz=0):
    T=np.eye(4); T[:3,:3]=Rot.from_euler('xyz',[rx,0,rz]).as_matrix(); T[:3,3]=t; return T

def fk(q):
    # Panda's serial joint origins; model tip is 20 cm below flange, with
    # a fixed 45-degree finger-frame yaw.
    T=np.eye(4)
    origins=[((0,0,.333),0),((0,0,0),-np.pi/2),((0,-.316,0),np.pi/2),((.0825,0,0),np.pi/2),((-.0825,.384,0),-np.pi/2),((0,0,0),np.pi/2),((.088,0,0),np.pi/2)]
    for i,(t,rx) in enumerate(origins):
        T=T@ht(t,rx)@ht(rz=q[i])
    T=T@ht((0,0,.2))@ht(rz=-np.pi/4)
    T[:3,3]=RBASE@T[:3,3]+np.array([0,-.405,.78])
    T[:3,:3]=RBASE@T[:3,:3]
    return T

def ik(pos,orientation,seed,rot_weight=.2):
    pos=np.asarray(pos); seed=np.asarray(seed)
    desired=Rot.from_quat(orientation,scalar_first=True)
    def err(q):
        T=fk(q); rot=Rot.from_matrix(T[:3,:3]);
        return np.r_[10*(T[:3,3]-pos),rot_weight*(desired*rot.inv()).as_rotvec(),.015*(q-seed)]
    ans=least_squares(err,np.clip(seed,LIM[:,0]+.001,LIM[:,1]-.001),bounds=(LIM[:,0]+.0001,LIM[:,1]-.0001),max_nfev=120)
    return ans.x, np.linalg.norm(err(ans.x)[:3]), np.linalg.norm(err(ans.x)[3:6])

class Driver:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r=Robot(); self.layout=self.r.spec()['proprio_layout']; self.log=[]
        self.obs=self.r.get_obs(cameras=['left','right','wrist'],video='none')
        self.update()
    def update(self):
        v=self.obs.meta['proprio']['now']; d=dict(zip(self.layout,v));
        self.q=np.array([d[f'joint{i}_pos'] for i in range(1,8)])
        self.finger=float((d['finger1_pos']+d['finger2_pos'])/2)
        self.pos=np.array([d[f'tcp_{c}'] for c in 'xyz'])
        self.quat=np.array([d[f'tcp_q{c}'] for c in 'wxyz'])
        print('state',self.obs.meta['control_steps'],'q',np.round(self.q,3),'finger',round(self.finger,3),'tcp',np.round(self.pos,3),'done',self.obs.meta['reason'],flush=True)
    def save(self,tag):
        p=OUT/tag; p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        for k,v in self.obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(v).save(p/f'{k}.png')
        (p/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.obs.meta,indent=2))
    def joint(self,q,fingers=None,duration=2,tag='move'):
        q=np.asarray(q); fingers=self.finger if fingers is None else fingers
        goal=np.r_[q,fingers,fingers]; start=np.r_[self.q,self.finger,self.finger]
        n=max(2,int(round(duration/.1))); rows=np.linspace(start,goal,n)
        self.obs=self.r.submit('joint_position',rows,dt=.1,interpolate='hold',cameras=['left','right','wrist'],video='none',note=tag)
        self.log.append(dict(tag=tag,goal=goal.tolist(),meta=self.obs.meta));(OUT/'log.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.log,indent=2))
        self.update();self.save(tag)
        return self.obs
    def move(self,pos,orientation=None,fingers=None,duration=2,tag='move'):
        q,e,re=ik(pos,self.quat if orientation is None else orientation,self.q)
        print('IK',tag,'target',np.round(pos,3),'q',np.round(q,3),'err',e,re,flush=True)
        if e>.08: raise RuntimeError(f'IK position error {e}')
        return self.joint(q,fingers,duration,tag)

if __name__=='__main__':
    d=Driver(); print('fk_error',fk(d.q)[:3,3]-d.pos)
